mapper.sql: WITH category_routes(code, path, fallback_label) AS ( VALUES ('COMMUNITY_GROUP_MANAGER'::text, '/community/group/manager'::text, '모임 현황'::text), ('COMMUNITY_GROUP_A1', '/community/group/groupa1', '모임 A1'), ('COMMUNITY_GROUP_B2', '/community/group/groupb2', '모임 B2'), ('COMMUNITY_FACILITIES_CALENDAR', '/community/facilities/calendar', '연간 일정'), ('COMMUNITY_FACILITIES_DINING', '/community/facilities/dining', '봉사 일정'), ('COMMUNITY_FACILITIES_PRAYER', '/community/facilities/prayer', '활동 일정'), ('COMMUNITY_SAINT_FAMILY', '/community/saint/family', '경조사'), ('COMMUNITY_SAINT_PRAY', '/community/saint/pray', '기도 제목'), ('COMMUNITY_SAINT_SALES', '/community/saint/sales', '알뜰 시장'), ('COMMUNITY_SAINT_JOB', '/community/saint/job', '채용 소식'), ('COMMUNITY_WORLD_CHRISTIAN', '/community/world/christian', '기독교 소식'), ('COMMUNITY_WORLD_ECONOMIC', '/community/world/economic', '경제 소식'), ('COMMUNITY_WORLD_HEALTH', '/community/world/health', '건강 소식') ), categories AS ( SELECT r.code, r.path, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.menu_nm, ''), r.fallback_label) AS label, COALESCE(m.param, '') AS param FROM category_routes r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT menu_nm, param FROM sys_menu WHERE path = r.path ORDER BY CASE WHEN level = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, menu_id LIMIT 1 ) m ON TRUE ), public_posts AS ( SELECT b.rqst_no, b.title, b.ins_dt, b.rqst_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(b.views, 0), 0)::bigint AS views, c.code, c.label, c.path, c.param FROM board b JOIN categories c ON c.code = b.board_type WHERE b.secret = 'N' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(b.password), '') IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT 'LIVE'::text AS source, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "asOf", TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "periodStart", TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "periodEnd"

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalPosts", COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(rqst_id), '')) AS contributors, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE ins_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ins_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS "currentMonthPosts", COALESCE(SUM(views), 0)::bigint AS "totalViews", COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE ins_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND ins_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS "periodPosts" FROM public_posts

, months AS ( SELECT generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS month_start ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(p.rqst_no) AS count FROM months m LEFT JOIN public_posts p ON p.ins_dt >= m.month_start AND p.ins_dt < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start

SELECT c.code, c.label, c.path, c.param, COUNT(p.rqst_no) AS count, COUNT(p.rqst_no) FILTER ( WHERE p.ins_dt >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '5 months' AND p.ins_dt < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS "periodCount" FROM categories c LEFT JOIN public_posts p ON p.code = c.code GROUP BY c.code, c.label, c.path, c.param ORDER BY count DESC, c.code

SELECT label AS category, path, param, COALESCE(title, '(제목 없음)') AS title, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(ins_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') AS date, views FROM public_posts ORDER BY ins_dt DESC NULLS LAST, rqst_no DESC LIMIT 6
